title: E&S Review linked engagement exchange
description: Vendor-neutral engagement domain. Identifiers are stable; records link original source versions without copying bytes. Source identity follows Dublin Core concepts, provenance follows W3C PROV concepts, thematic concepts can map to SKOS. Schema validation covers shape; validateEngagementPackages additionally verifies relational closure, role authority, complete revision histories, source hashes, audit chains and approved snapshot SHA256. Declared local roles are not remote authentication or legally binding signatures. This document validates individual engagement packages, immutable approved snapshots, and the esia-engagement-project-exchange HTTP export/import envelope. Full source-project portable packages use their independently versioned esia-local-project envelope and embed these validated engagement packages; original source bytes are validated by the source-project importer. Monitoring arrays and cycle-linked fields are additive optional schema-version-1 extensions. Older approved snapshots remain byte-identical and retain their original hashes; default empty monitoring arrays are read projections only.

fieldCaptureBinding.description: Server-owned capture-time evidence provenance. Domain validation additionally checks exact original bytes, graph membership, uploader attribution, immutable revision continuity and canonical source identities. Lease expiry does not rewrite historical evidence.

revisionRelation.title: Human-reviewed exact-version document relationship
revisionRelation.description: Optional additive source metadata. Absence preserves legacy records. A relationship keeps physical resource and original version identities unchanged.

authenticatedProjectExchange.description: Authenticated repository exchange retains the authorized source projection and source metadata history. Source authority and originals are validated independently; this is not a bearer authorization or public import endpoint.

reviewDurationMinutes.description: Optional self-reported human review duration in minutes for this exact substantive finding-review decision; this is not measured session time or an AI estimate.
